home.intro: Short units of 5 to 10 minutes. No streaks, no pressure. Take your time.
home.sessionPlaceholder: Your first reading texts are being prepared.

comprehensibleInput.name: Comprehensible input
comprehensibleInput.description: Short texts just above your level. You understand most of it and pick up the rest from context.

spacedRepetition.name: Spaced repetition
spacedRepetition.description: Each word comes back right before you would forget it, at growing intervals.

activeRecall.name: Active recall
activeRecall.description: First try to remember on your own, then see the answer. That is what makes it stick.

interfaceLanguage.title: Interface language
interfaceLanguage.description: Language of menus and explanations. Your learning language is chosen separately.
